description: This file is a shell script used for testing git diff behavior with submodules, encoding, and related functionalities. It includes setup, test cases, and validation logic for various scenarios involving submodules, nested submodules, encoding, and file modifications within git repositories.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a git repository with specified names and commits them with a message.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit in the current repository with a given message.

methods.name: diff_cmp
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs after normalizing certain fields.
